definitions.explanation: An academic division within a university.

examples.japanese: {法学部|ほうがくぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}って→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}したい→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧。
examples.english: I want to enter the Faculty of Law and study law.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{六|ろく}つ→六つ：02974_muttsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{学部|がくぶ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入学|にゅうがく}する→入学：02092_nyuugaku⟧。
examples.english: This university has six faculties, and many students enroll every year.

notes:
{学部|がくぶ} refers to a faculty or department within a university - the major academic divisions of undergraduate study.

KANJI BREAKDOWN:
- {学|がく}: learning, study
- {部|ぶ}: department, section

USAGE AS SUFFIX:
Often attached to field names: 〜{学部|がくぶ}
- ⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧{学部|がくぶ}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧: What department are you in?

COMMON UNIVERSITY FACULTIES:
- ⟦{文学部|ぶんがくぶ}→文学部：24048_bungakubu⟧: Faculty of Literature/Humanities
- ⟦{法学部|ほうがくぶ}→法学部：24334_hougakubu⟧: Faculty of Law
- ⟦{経済学部|けいざいがくぶ}→経済学部：24491_keizaigakubu⟧: Faculty of Economics
- ⟦{商学部|しょうがくぶ}→商学部：27974_shougakubu⟧: Faculty of Commerce
- ⟦{工学部|こうがくぶ}→工学部：24493_kougakubu⟧: Faculty of Engineering
- ⟦{理学部|りがくぶ}→理学部：24492_rigakubu⟧: Faculty of Science
- ⟦{医学部|いがくぶ}→医学部：27620_igakubu⟧: Faculty of Medicine
- ⟦{薬学部|やくがくぶ}→薬学部：28157_yakugakubu⟧: Faculty of Pharmacy
- ⟦{教育学部|きょういくがくぶ}→教育学部：28158_kyouikugakubu⟧: Faculty of Education
- ⟦{農学部|のうがくぶ}→農学部：28399_nougakubu⟧: Faculty of Agriculture

RELATED VOCABULARY:
- ⟦{学科|がっか}→学科：00053_gakka⟧: department (subdivision within a faculty)
- ⟦{専攻|せんこう}→専攻：01587_senkou⟧: major, specialization
- ⟦{大学院|だいがくいん}→大学院：04783_daigakuin⟧: graduate school
- ⟦{研究科|けんきゅうか}→研究科：25123_kenkyuuka⟧: graduate school division
- ⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧: student
- ⟦{教授|きょうじゅ}→教授：02589_kyouju⟧: professor

JAPANESE UNIVERSITY STRUCTURE:
Japanese universities are organized into {学部|がくぶ} (faculties) for undergraduate studies, which are further divided into ⟦{学科|がっか}→学科：00053_gakka⟧ (departments). Graduate studies are organized into ⟦{研究科|けんきゅうか}→研究科：25123_kenkyuuka⟧.
